game.title: BioShock Infinite
game.blurb: Story-driven first-person shooter set in the floating city of Columbia, from Irrational Games (RAWG also lists 2K Australia and Aspyr Media), published by 2K Games, released 2013-03-26. RAWG average playtime: 12 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Story milestones in Columbia, all hidden on Steam. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Weapons, Vigors and Combat
chapters.summary: Kills with each weapon, Vigors and their combinations, Sky-Line and Sky-Hook attacks, Tears, possessed machines and environmental hazards.

chapters.title: Gear, Upgrades and Looting
chapters.summary: Gear slots, weapon, Vigor and attribute upgrades, Infusions, lock-picking with Elizabeth, vending machines and containers.

chapters.title: Telescopes, Kinetoscopes and Voxophones
chapters.summary: Using every telescope and Kinetoscope and collecting every Voxophone.

chapters.title: 1999 Mode
chapters.summary: Finishing the game in 1999 Mode without buying from a Dollar Bill machine.

chapters.title: Clash in the Clouds
chapters.summary: The four arenas (The OPS Zeal, Duke and Dimwit Theater, Raven's Dome and Emporia Arcade), the Gallery and the Blue Ribbon Challenges.

chapters.title: Burial at Sea - Episode One
chapters.summary: Audio Diaries, Old Man Winter and Radar Range feats, turrets and upgrades, plus two hidden story achievements. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Burial at Sea - Episode Two
chapters.summary: Audio Diaries and Voxophones, noisemakers, Gas Bolts, Freight Hooks, Peeping Tom and Ironsides, plus five hidden story achievements. Spoiler-guarded.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 8870)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/BioShock_Infinite
Fandom (bioshock.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://bioshock.fandom.com/wiki/BioShock_Infinite
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 4062); RAWG keeps "Bioshock Infinite: Clash in the Clouds", "BioShock Infinite: Burial at Sea - Episode One" and "Episode Two" as separate entries. Steam app 8870 ("BioShock Infinite"; schema "Bioshock Infinite") holds the achievements for all three, so each gets its own chapter. StrategyWiki has "BioShock Infinite" at completion stage 1, but its Walkthrough is linked and not written. Only Achievements and trophies (about 14,000 characters), Controls (about 2,100), Gameplay (about 300) and four Clash in the Clouds arena pages (The OPS Zeal, Duke and Dimwit Theater, Raven's Dome and Emporia Arcade, about 1,000 to 1,200 characters each) exist; the Clash in the Clouds index, Gear, Vigors, Weapons, Voxophones, Kinetoscopes and Telescopes pages are not written, so it was not used. bioshock.fandom.com answers the API under "BioShock Infinite" with about 148 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 21 of 80 Steam achievements are hidden. Achievement_1 to Achievement_14 (2.8% to 91.8%) look like main-story milestones and sit in that chapter; two of them, "Stone Cold Pinkerton" (9.3%) and "Auld Lang Syne" (2.8%), are much rarer than the rest and may not be plain story beats. ACHIEVEMENT_61 and 62 sit among the Episode One achievements in the Steam list and ACHIEVEMENT_70 to 73 and 75 among the Episode Two ones, so they were put in those chapters by list position, a reasoned guess. ACHIEVEMENT_76, 77, 79 and 80 (noisemakers, Gas Bolt, Freight Hook, Peeping Tom) do not name an episode but sit in the Episode Two block, so they were put there too. "Break the Ice" and "Snowball Effect" name Old Man Winter, which an Episode One achievement also names, so they are in Episode One.
